stories.title: Dart to have surgery, miss regular season; Harbaugh won't rule out playoffs
stories.summary: Giants quarterback Jaxson Dart will undergo surgery on his left knee and sit out the rest of the regular season, though head coach John Harbaugh didn't rule out the possibility Dart could return if the Giants were to make the playoffs.

stories.title: Judge says he intends to be available for G1 of AL Wild Card Series
stories.summary: Yankees' slugger Aaron Judge told ESPN on Wednesday that he intends to be ready for Game 1 of the AL Wild Card Series at Yankee Stadium next Tuesday.

stories.title: Guerrero doubles down on contract comments: 'What I said is the way I feel'
stories.summary: Blue Jays first baseman Vladimir Guerrero Jr. is standing by comments he made during a recent interview regarding his performance this season after signing a 14-year, $500 million contract last year.

stories.title: NASCAR great D. Waltrip battling brain disease, steps back from public life
stories.summary: Darrell Waltrip, who parlayed a Hall of Fame driving career in NASCAR into a longtime broadcasting stint at Fox Sports, has stepped away from public life due to a progressive brain disease.

stories.title: Seahawks coach apologizes to Payton for comments: 'Lesson learned'
stories.summary: Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald said Wednesday he called Broncos coach Sean Payton and apologized for comments he made in a published video that went viral Tuesday.
